note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = dial centre. Plan sizes from the trace of the straightened front photo (43 mm case, listing; strap between the lugs 21.3 mm measured, listing 22 mm; listing: 13 mm thick). Heights before the house depth scale. Dial print, sub-dial rings and tracks, gold 24 h batons, logo and the rehaut come from the dial map; the strap leather from the strap map (12 o'clock strap of the photo, both sides).

case.note: (r, z): polished flank rounding into the thin polished bezel (19.8-20.9 mm in the photo); inner lip over the rehaut

lug.note: plain polished lugs from the traced silhouette, top sloping down from the case to the tip; wide edge radius for the rounded outer flank of the photo; end cut square over the last 1.2 mm (photo)

crystal.note: high domed crystal sitting on the bezel top (photo: strong edge glare)

hands.note: ridge before the depth scale: about 12 deg facets after it, enough to split light and dark like the photo; minute ridge top 8.05 under the collet top (8.1) and the crystal (8.2)

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips (24.36 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

hand_dark.note: faceted dark steel hour and minute hands: one facet near black, the other grey in the photo

hub_grey.note: centre collet and cap: mid grey in the photo, polished ring at the cap edge

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass. Black base colour keeps the dial from hazing
